events.text: The garden is full of pretty things.
I want to pick her some flowers.
But how many flowers should I pick?
I am Bea the bee. I love this garden.
I visit every flower in the garden.
Hello Bea! Can you help me count?
Yes! Counting is my favourite thing.
How many sunflowers can you see?
Can you count them with me?
Little red ladybirds on the leaf.
Red apples on the little tree.
How many apples? Count with us.
One, two, three, four. Four apples!
Here are the pretty pink flowers.
This is for Ellie. Count them all!
Five flowers. What a lovely present.
Now let's count them all again!
We counted all the way to five!
Ellie! We made something for you.
Thank you Milo. Thank you Bea.
Can you count them one more time?
Come and count again soon. Bye bye!

cues.text: Milo: Today is Ellie's special day.
Milo: The garden is full of pretty things.
Milo: I want to pick her some flowers.
Milo: But how many flowers should I pick?
Bea: Buzz buzz! Hello down there!
Milo: Oh! Who are you?
Bea: I am Bea the bee. I love this garden.
Bea: I visit every flower in the garden.
Milo: Hello Bea! Can you help me count?
Bea: Yes! Counting is my favourite thing.
Bea: Look! A big yellow sunflower.
Milo: It is taller than me!
Milo: How many sunflowers can you see?
Bea: One! One tall sunflower.
Milo: Bea, look at the butterflies!
Bea: Can you count them with me?
Bea: One, two. Two butterflies!
Bea: Little red ladybirds on the leaf.
Milo: They have tiny black spots.
Milo: Let's count the ladybirds. Ready?
Milo: One, two, three. Three ladybirds!
Milo: Red apples on the little tree.
Bea: They look juicy and sweet.
Bea: How many apples? Count with us.
Bea: One, two, three, four. Four apples!
Bea: Here are the pretty pink flowers.
Milo: This is for Ellie. Count them all!
Milo: One, two, three, four, five!
Bea: Five flowers. What a lovely present.
Bea: Now let's count them all again!
Bea: One sunflower.
Milo: Two butterflies.
Bea: Three ladybirds.
Milo: Four apples.
Bea: Five flowers for Ellie.
Milo: We counted all the way to five!
Milo: Ellie! We made something for you.
Ellie: Oh my! Flowers for me?
Bea: Milo counted every single one.
Ellie: Thank you Milo. Thank you Bea.
Milo: Can you count them one more time?
One, two, three, four, five!
Ellie: You counted beautifully. Well done!
Milo: Come and count again soon. Bye bye!
